description: This file defines a Contact class used to represent contact entities in an Android application, including static contact list and methods to access contact details.

classes.name: Contact
classes.description: Represents a contact with a name and provides static methods and data for contact management.

methods.name: Contact(String name)
methods.description: Constructor to create a Contact with the specified name.

methods.name: byId(int id)
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a Contact from the CONTACTS array by its index.

methods.name: getName()
methods.description: Returns the name of the contact.

methods.name: getIcon()
methods.description: Returns the icon resource ID associated with the contact.
